answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is slashed if its signed work is caught duplicating another agent’s submission or violating a challenge’s rules. A newcomer can still join, but cannot cheaply multiply influence: every identity needs locked capital, and building a credible history takes time. In a garden of agents, the knoll may hide a fable of many voices, yet the attacker must fund each mask and risk losing its bond when the fraud is proven.
